reviewer: original_character subagent; authored body cage, separate read-only review phase; not an external independent art reviewer

render_conditions.evidence_type: Actual Blender EEVEE gray/clay orthographic studio PNGs, not generated illustration or Godot gameplay.
render_conditions.condition_basis: Candidate manifest labels fixed studio render; corresponding baseline detail file names and framing were compared.
render_conditions.limitation: Exact camera/light equality across baseline/candidate was not independently remeasured here. Body/head and bounded rig corrective changes coexist, so this visual comparison does not isolate a single numerical cause.

comparative_findings.observed_change: Nasal openings/bridge, eye-center relief and a distinct auricle patch read more clearly than the nearly featureless baseline.
comparative_findings.remaining: Rectangular ear base in front, concentric washer-like auricle from side, pinched/wedge nose and simplified brow/cheek/jaw/neck. These are prototype sculpt issues, not solved human likeness.

comparative_findings.observed_change: At most a subtle local floor/crease contour adjustment; no large transformation in the 10-detail A/B.
comparative_findings.remaining: Broad U-shaped web to neck/chest and long flat side planes remain under raised arms. Do not claim axillary anatomy solved.

comparative_findings.observed_change: Small contour/crease shifts in the proximal thigh attachment.
comparative_findings.remaining: Visible diagonal hip ridge in squat, rounded paired buttock masses/central V and rigid lower torso remain. No natural pose art acceptance.

comparative_findings.observed_change: The same five-finger and five-toe shapes are retained visually.
comparative_findings.remaining: Thumb-root triangular highlight/step, flat hand planes, blunt finger/toe tips and round heel remain. Not new improvements in EXP37.

source_readonly_head_review.reviewed_scope: Cage bridge/rectangular boundary, build_head cut patches and eye/lip/nasal/auricular loops read without running bpy.
source_readonly_head_review.finding: Eye/mouth/nasal/ear rectangles use disjoint grid sectors; surrounding face and inset cavities are explicitly bridged/capped. No obvious indexing omission was identified in this read-through. This is not an independent manifold or ocular self-intersection test.
source_readonly_head_review.plausibility_limit: The ear code uses several nearly concentric elliptical stages and a regular patch root, consistent with the observed washer/rectangular-base appearance. Named loops and closed topology alone do not establish plausible anatomy.

rejected_history.basis: Read candidates/v01/disposition.json; not newly reopened in this 36-original review.
rejected_history.reason: Rectangular auricle attachment and plate-like nostril rim rejected; prior raw render/source evidence retained.

rejected_history.basis: Read candidates/v02/disposition.json; not newly reopened in this 36-original review.
rejected_history.reason: Rounded root did not remove projecting nasal wing plates; v03 changes surrounding maxillary/philtral plane and embeds smaller rim.

observations_vs_inference.direct: Per-image observations above are actual viewed pixels. Hashes/dimensions are file reads. Current/frozen source equality was recomputed.
observations_vs_inference.inference: Potential causes from loop geometry are a read-through interpretation. Black creases/noisy shading were not labeled holes or topology failures from color alone.
observations_vs_inference.not_claimed: No fresh engine test, numeric contact/volume proof, global self-intersection proof, continuous movement quality, user comfort or human resemblance acceptance.
